notes: All-cash buyer ISO for a Tribeca loft, broadcast to network. shouldExtractParty=true; address must be null (buyer is looking). Grades neighborhood/borough of the search area.

input.subject: ISO Tribeca loft, all cash, up to $6M - qualified buyer
input.bodyText:
Hey all,

Working with a serious all-cash buyer relocating from SF. Looking for a true loft feel in Tribeca:

- 2BR+ / 2BA, minimum 1,800 sf
- High ceilings (12ft+), original details, big windows
- Prewar conversion preferred, condo or condop
- Budget to $6M, flexible for the right space
- No board approval headaches - they want to close fast

Would consider northern Soho too. Send me anything off-market or coming soon. Full co-broke.

Priya Anand
SERHANT.
(646) 555-0173
